title: Two-group comparison of gene signatures: failure of conventional statistical methods and validation of a novel algorithm
protocol: Install CalcHEPI Add-in by opening Excel and inserting the program CD into the drive.
In Excel, click on 'Add-Ins' under the 'Tools' menu, then select 'Browse'.
Locate and double-click on 'HEPI' to install it.
Click 'Yes' when prompted to confirm copying HEPI to your system.
Ensure 'HEPI' appears on the menu bar after installation is complete.
Remove the software CD from the drive if applicable.
For uninstallation, follow similar steps but select 'HEPI Uninstall'.
Enter gene expression data of different groups in separate columns for computing HEPI score.
Activate the 'Input' window before entering data to ensure proper comparison.
Click the 'HEPI' button in the menu bar to pop up the 'Input' window.
Select the range of data (numbers only) without including the header row.
Click the 'OK' button to execute the software and display a comprehensive report.
